evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、skills/superdesign/SKILL.md、dsh/index.js、skills/superdesign/references/RESUME.md、package.json；DSH provider发布一个Skill树；Agent按任务路由参考，通过外部CLI创建、迭代和恢复草稿。
limitations: 核查DSH注册、Skill路由与续作协议，未执行外部CLI、上传本地源码或审计云服务。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 面向在已有代码库持续迭代UI与视觉草稿的开发者和设计者。
DSH provider发布一个Skill树；Agent按任务路由参考，通过外部CLI创建、迭代和恢复草稿。
核查DSH注册、Skill路由与续作协议，未执行外部CLI、上传本地源码或审计云服务。
package声明DSH bundle且直接ESM provider发布Skill；外部@superdesign/cli需独立取得和登录。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | CLI、服务和模型用量 | init、现状复制、上下文筛选 | 价格及准备时间未知 |
| 持续使用 | 设计迭代与素材生成 | 选择方向、视觉复核和状态维护 | 哈希复用只可能节省发现成本 |
| 失败恢复 | 重复生成可能追加用量 | 核对远端project/draft后重试 | 本仓库无服务幂等证明 |
| 退出 | 导出设计与保存笔记 | 停用CLI/Skill并清理远端数据 | 服务数据删除规则未知 |

已有设计任务者可用可公开UI片段进行小范围试用，先核对费用和发送内容。涉及不可外发源码或需要确定性本地修正时，直接在本地设计系统和代码上修改。
有设计迭代需求者可先用可公开UI片段试用，核对发送文件、费用和目标草稿后再生成；私密源码或确定性小修优先本地直接修改，不把缓存状态当持续上传许可。[Q03](#research-q03)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 连续设计状态 | 目标、草稿与哈希的协议 | 实际节省时间与遗漏依赖 |
| 宿主加载 | provider list/get与apply | 当前宿主真实兼容 |
| 设计质量 | 作者产品主张 | 视觉偏好、代码可用性和费用 |
可借鉴的是把远端草稿、精确上下文路径及全文件哈希绑定到稳定页面目标；明确选择源草稿而不从版本号猜方向，也不在多分支时自动替用户挑选。适配器从Skill原文读取description，减少双处描述漂移。
把现状、设计系统、目标草稿和预算化上下文接到可继续的设计流程，贡献在方法与包装，不能算外部设计模型原创。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02)
缓存路径检查与上传限制是文本协议，未见本仓库强制验证器；CLI和云端实现不在此处，不能把要求写成已实现隔离或效果保证。[Q02](#research-q02)
比较依赖感知的定向刷新与全量发现，检查共享视觉依赖变化时陈旧草稿和人工修正；先核对现有规则，尚未验证。[Q04](#research-q04)

technical.rationale: Q02、Q04为成熟provider与状态缓存方法的组合，novelty/mechanism25%；目标状态迁移50%、续作简化50%，不把云模型算本仓库创新。

business.rationale: Q01设计前后状态与草稿交接50%、可分支视觉交付50%、跨宿主Skill入口50%；经济只有可能减少重复发现25%，未测。

recommendation.reason: 有持续UI设计需求的编码Agent用户可用公开示例界面试用。相比一次性写HTML，它把设计系统、现状草稿和跨会话目标状态串在一起。若不能接受源码外发、费用不明确或只是确定性小修，就退回本地设计系统与直接编辑。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)已有代码UI反复迭代与草稿交接具体，75%超泛用途50%；独立需求不充分不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)与[Q04](#research-q04)目标/哈希协议有可解释50%增量；强制执行和效果未知不足75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)本仓库只提供注册和协议，关键外部CLI未固定检查，仅25%；不足核心全链路50%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)公开样本与本地编辑退路使负担可控50%；账号、费用和数据删除未知，不取75%。

data.reports:
# Superdesign Skill > 为编码Agent提供UI、演示稿和图形设计流程，并通过CLI连接Superdesign画布。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[superdesigndev/superdesign-skill](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill) - **版本号**：0.6.0（[固定提交 f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/tree/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-21（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 Skill注册与续作协议已检查；外部设计引擎、实际上传与审美收益未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：面向在已有代码库持续迭代UI与视觉草稿的开发者和设计者。 - **亮点**：把现状、设计系统、目标草稿和预算化上下文接到可继续的设计流程，贡献在方法与包装，不能算外部设计模型原创。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) - **思考**：缓存路径检查与上传限制是文本协议，未见本仓库强制验证器；CLI和云端实现不在此处，不能把要求写成已实现隔离或效果保证。[Q02](#research-q02) - **建议**：比较依赖感知的定向刷新与全量发现，检查共享视觉依赖变化时陈旧草稿和人工修正；先核对现有规则，尚未验证。[Q04](#research-q04) 采用建议：有设计迭代需求者可先用可公开UI片段试用，核对发送文件、费用和目标草稿后再生成；私密源码或确定性小修优先本地直接修改，不把缓存状态当持续上传许可。[Q03](#research-q03) ## 核心贡献 把现状、设计系统、目标草稿和预算化上下文接到可继续的设计流程，贡献在方法与包装，不能算外部设计模型原创。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 缓存路径检查与上传限制是文本协议，未见本仓库强制验证器；CLI和云端实现不在此处，不能把要求写成已实现隔离或效果保证。[Q02](#research-q02) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 比较依赖感知的定向刷新与全量发现，检查共享视觉依赖变化时陈旧草稿和人工修正；先核对现有规则，尚未验证。[Q04](#research-q04) 在公开UI样本比较冷/暖恢复及共享token变化，记录陈旧设计、上下文量、视觉修改和费用。 ## 场景与替代办法 面向在已有代码库持续迭代UI与视觉草稿的开发者和设计者。 本地设计系统加直接HTML/CSS编辑，或现有设计工具。远端画布的价值需与上下文准备和复核成本一起比较。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | 兼容宿主与Skill入口 | 必需 | 读方法与参考 | 不安装重复入口 | | shell、Superdesign CLI与登录 | 远端设计必需 | 项目与草稿调用 | 只有Skill文件不能设计 | | 有意选择的UI源码与素材 | 现有项目设计必需 | 上下文和品牌 | 不把整个工程自动上传 | | 费用和数据范围确认 | 远端操作必需 | 控制模型调用及源码发送 | 当前价格与保留策略未核实 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 1 | 用户核对CLI、登录与公开示例范围 | 能明确将发送哪些文件 | | 2 | Agent提取设计系统并指定目标草稿 | 目标ID与当前方向一致 | | 3 | 用户审阅一次迭代及本地导出 | 检查视觉、可编辑性与费用 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次使用 | CLI、服务和模型用量 | init、现状复制、上下文筛选 | 价格及准备时间未知 | | 持续使用 | 设计迭代与素材生成 | 选择方向、视觉复核和状态维护 | 哈希复用只可能节省发现成本 | | 失败恢复 | 重复生成可能追加用量 | 核对远端project/draft后重试 | 本仓库无服务幂等证明 | | 退出 | 导出设计与保存笔记 | 停用CLI/Skill并清理远端数据 | 服务数据删除规则未知 | 已有设计任务者可用可公开UI片段进行小范围试用，先核对费用和发送内容。涉及不可外发源码或需要确定性本地修正时，直接在本地设计系统和代码上修改。 #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 连续设计状态 | 目标、草稿与哈希的协议 | 实际节省时间与遗漏依赖 | | 宿主加载 | provider list/get与apply | 当前宿主真实兼容 | | 设计质量 | 作者产品主张 | 视觉偏好、代码可用性和费用 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：设计上下文及草稿续作协议能否减少重复发现，远端依赖与上传边界是什么？ ### Q01 · 设计Skill比通用前端提示增加什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 面向在已有代码库迭代UI、演示稿或营销图的开发者和设计者。交付是可分支设计草稿、设计系统与可继续编辑的上下文，而不是直接宣称生产页面已验收。相较一次让模型写HTML，协议要求先识别已有代码、提取设计系统并区分现有页面复制与新设计，让不同方向可比较且能继续。 贡献主要是工作方法与跨宿主包装；审美质量、设计模型和云画布属于外部Superdesign产品，本仓库没有该引擎实现。简单确定的CSS或文案修正可直接在本地完成，不必初始化整套远端项目。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:17-25](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/README.md#L17-L25) 作者说明目标人群、设计系统与跨会话续作。 ```text **Superdesign is an AI product design agent.** It gives coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 70+ others) real design judgment, so the UI they ship looks considered instead of generic. - **What it does** — finds design direction, sets up design systems, approves presentation outlines, and generates + iterates high-quality UI, slide decks, and graphics on an infinite canvas. - **Who it's for** — developers, indie hackers, and product/UI designers who want to go from idea to shippable UI fast without leaving their coding agent. - **How it's different** — style-preset skills just swap in a theme or a component library. Superdesign designs *into* your existing design system: it reads your code for context, gathers real style references, and produces branchable drafts you refine. - **Cross-session continuity** — after the first real-codebase design, the skill remembers the project, draft, extracted components, and budgeted source-context bundle so later unchanged iterations resume without repeating codebase discovery. - **Two ways in** — this skill from any coding agent, or the web app at [superdesign.dev](https://superdesign.dev). > **Not the legacy IDE extension.** The archived open-source `superdesigndev/superdesign` VS Code extension is an older, separate project. This skill and [superdesign.dev](https://superdesign.dev) are the current, maintained product. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[skills/superdesign/SKILL.md:10-22](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/skills/superdesign/SKILL.md#L10-L22) Skill按任务路由不同参考并区分继续与分支。
查看原文（13行） ```text # Core scenarios (what this skill handles) 1. **Analyze a codebase for design work** — `superdesign init` builds reusable UI context in `.superdesign/init/`; read [INIT.md](references/INIT.md). 2. **Design, reproduce, or improve UI** — create pages, features, flows, and new products on the canvas; read [SUPERDESIGN.md](references/SUPERDESIGN.md). 3. **Choose and compare leading design models** — run `list-models`, select a model suited to the task, or use different models to explore independent directions. 4. **Create design systems and reusable components** — establish visual foundations, extract patterns, and design connected multi-page experiences. 5. **Design from a live website or reference URL** — extract and apply its design language; read [WEBSITE.md](references/WEBSITE.md). 6. **Create or export presentations** — plan an editable slide outline, approve it in chat, generate a real presentation draft, make slide-safe edits, or reconstruct an editable PPTX when requested and supported; read [PRESENTATION.md](references/PRESENTATION.md). 7. **Create graphics** — posters, covers, social posts, thumbnails, flyers, and ads; read [GRAPHIC.md](references/GRAPHIC.md). 8. **Generate supporting images or video** — use native image generation when appropriate or choose from Superdesign's generation models; read [ASSET_GENERATION.md](references/ASSET_GENERATION.md). 9. **Continue or directly correct existing work** — resume saved targets through [RESUME.md](references/RESUME.md), or use [design-with-your-model.md](references/design-with-your-model.md) when direct authoring is the right path. When continuing a draft, follow [SUPERDESIGN.md](references/SUPERDESIGN.md) **ITERATION MODE ROUTING**: replace refines the selected direction with version history; branch is only for alternatives the user wants to compare. ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[README.md:144-160](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/README.md#L144-L160) 复制现状和设计修改明确分开。
查看原文（17行） ```text ## replica_html_template rules (Canvas only) The purpose of replica html template is creating a lightweight version of existing UI so design agent can iterate on top of it (Since superdesign doesn't have access to your codebase directly, this is important context) Overall process for designing features on top of existing app: 1. Identify & understand existing UI of page related 2. Create/update a pixel perfect replica html in `.superdesign/replica_html_template/.html` (Only replicate how UI look now, do NOT design) - If design task is redesign profile page, then replicate current profile page UI pixel perfectly - If design task is add new button to side panel, identify which page side panel is using, then replicate that page UI pixel perfectly **replica_html_template = BEFORE state (what exists now).** It provides context for Superdesign agent. Actual design will be done via superdesign agent, by passing the prompt The replica_html_template must contain **ONLY UI that currently exists in the codebase**. - **DO NOT** design or improve anything in the replica_html_template - **DO NOT** add placeholder sections like `` - **DO** create pixel-perfect replica of current UI state ```
### Q02 · DSH注册和续作缓存分别由谁执行？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 dsh/index.js直接读取打包Skill内容及description，list/get返回resourceBase、rank和可调用信息，apply注册skills provider。无构建步骤的小ESM适配器减少额外宿主依赖副本，实际注册的是一个Skill，不是多个设计模型工具。 RESUME文本要求把resume.json当仓库不可信缓存，验证路径、符号链接、秘密输入、目标ID与contextFiles/fingerprint集合后再调用CLI；全文件哈希匹配才走暖恢复。这是给执行Agent的协议，仓库未提供执行这些检查的独立强制验证器，不能当作程序已阻止路径逃逸或秘密上传。保存的远端ID也不代表上传授权。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[dsh/index.js:62-96](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/dsh/index.js#L62-L96) provider从同一Skill原文生成候选和内容。
查看原文（35行） ```text async function loadSkill(signal) { const content = await readFile(SKILL_BODY_URL, { encoding: 'utf8', signal }) const description = readDescription(content) if (description === undefined) return undefined return { description, content } } const provider = { name: PROVIDER_NAME, async list(options = {}) { const skill = await loadSkill(options.signal) if (skill === undefined) return [] return [{ name: SKILL_NAME, description: skill.description, invocation: INVOCATION, provider: PROVIDER_NAME, source: 'bundled', resourceBase: RESOURCE_BASE, rank: BUNDLED_SKILL_RANK, locator: SKILL_BODY_URL, }] }, async get(_candidate, options = {}) { const skill = await loadSkill(options.signal) if (skill === undefined) return undefined return { name: SKILL_NAME, description: skill.description, invocation: INVOCATION, provider: PROVIDER_NAME, source: 'bundled', resourceBase: RESOURCE_BASE, content: skill.content, } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh/index.js:100-112](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/dsh/index.js#L100-L112) DSH实际注册skills provider。
查看原文（13行） ```text /** Cordis plugin name. */ export const name = 'superdesign-skill' /** The registry this plugin contributes to. */ export const inject = ['skills'] /** * Register the packaged Superdesign skill on `ctx.skills`. * * @param {import('@deepseek-ai/cordis').Context} ctx - the plugin context. */ export function apply(ctx) { ctx.skills.registerProvider(() => provider) } ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[skills/superdesign/references/RESUME.md:67-93](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill/blob/f9f05cd988c247dce6c072eaf9ac6b162f2ffc4b/skills/superdesign/references/RESUME.md#L67-L93) 缓存字段和信任检查的文本要求。
查看原文（27行） ```text Rules: - Keys in `targets` are stable route or feature identifiers (`/`, `/dashboard`, `settings-panel`). - A target created by `execute-flow-pages` may also store `sourceTarget` and `sourceDraftId` to preserve its origin. These fields are informational; its own `activeDraftId`, context, and fingerprints control later resume. - `contextFiles` stores the exact, already-budgeted `--context-file` arguments, including line ranges. Do not rediscover or reread them on an ordinary warm resume; after the trust checks below, pass the validated entries to the next generation command. Read or extend only the smallest relevant subset when the request triggers **Targeted context expansion** below. - `referenceIds` optionally stores only the curated canvas image-node ids and Brand Asset keys that remain relevant to this target. It never stores local paths or implies permission to upload again. Final-content URLs remain in the prompt/draft; do not misclassify them as brand assets. - `brandAssets.logo` records the selected logo's Brand Asset key, canonical public URL, and optional safe repo-relative source path. Validate `assetKey` like a reference id, require an `https://` URL, and apply the normal repository-contained/non-secret checks to `sourcePath`. This is render state, not upload permission. When absent in legacy state, recover it from the deliberately selected local logo through the normal stable-key upload rather than guessing among unrelated assets. - A logo-bearing component record stores `logoAssetKey`. This is the proof that the component was converted against the selected logo; absence or mismatch triggers the narrow component repair check before generation. - `fingerprints` keys are real file paths without line-range suffixes. Hash the whole underlying file with SHA-256 (`sha256sum` when available, otherwise `shasum -a 256`). Hashing is a cheap freshness check; do not print or read the file contents into model context while doing it. - Include every underlying context file in `fingerprints`. A target entry is not valid if a context file is absent from the fingerprint map. - Keep `drafts` descriptive enough to distinguish parallel visual branches across sessions. Never infer the active visual direction from a version number alone. - When one branch/replace/revert result is unambiguous, set it as `activeDraftId`. [![Superdesign skill demo](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/AZYJWyWZ6pQ/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://youtu.be/AZYJWyWZ6pQ) *▶ Watch the skill in action.* --- ## What is Superdesign? **Superdesign is an AI product design agent.** It gives coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 70+ others) real design judgment, so the UI they ship looks considered instead of generic. - **What it does** — finds design direction, sets up design systems, approves presentation outlines, and generates + iterates high-quality UI, slide decks, and graphics on an infinite canvas. - **Who it's for** — developers, indie hackers, and product/UI designers who want to go from idea to shippable UI fast without leaving their coding agent. - **How it's different** — style-preset skills just swap in a theme or a component library. Superdesign designs *into* your existing design system: it reads your code for context, gathers real style references, and produces branchable drafts you refine. - **Cross-session continuity** — after the first real-codebase design, the skill remembers the project, draft, extracted components, and budgeted source-context bundle so later unchanged iterations resume without repeating codebase discovery. - **Two ways in** — this skill from any coding agent, or the web app at [superdesign.dev](https://superdesign.dev). > **Not the legacy IDE extension.** The archived open-source `superdesigndev/superdesign` VS Code extension is an older, separate project. This skill and [superdesign.dev](https://superdesign.dev) are the current, maintained product. --- ## Install **Any coding agent** — installs the skill for any of the [70+ supported coding agents](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills#supported-agents): ``` npx skills add superdesigndev/superdesign-skill ``` **Claude Code** — install it as a plugin instead, so it stays namespaced and updates with `/plugin update`: ``` /plugin marketplace add superdesigndev/superdesign-skill /plugin install superdesign@superdesign ``` The skill is then invoked as `/superdesign:superdesign`. (Do not also run `npx skills add` in Claude Code — that installs a second, unnamespaced copy of the same skill.) Either way, install the CLI it drives: ``` npm install -g @superdesign/cli@latest superdesign login ``` ## Use it Just talk to your agent: ``` /superdesign help me redesign this settings page so it doesn't look like default AI slop ``` ``` /superdesign set up a design system from my current codebase ``` ``` /superdesign improve the design of my dashboard ``` ``` /superdesign create an 8-slide presentation about our product launch ``` The skill handles the rest: it reads your code for context, gathers real style references, and produces design drafts you can branch and refine. --- # Core scenarios (what this skill handles) 1. **Design or improve UI** (feature/page/flow) 2. **Create a presentation** with an editable approved outline 3. **Create graphics** (posters, covers, social posts, and ads) 4. **Set or extract a design system** 5. **Generate supporting images or video** ## Tooling overview ### A) Inspiration & Style Tools (generic, always available) Use these to discover style direction, references, and brand context.
